assign.outcome:
**Figma-style group selection landed in ext/Panel — a RULE, not a class.** size.js's grouped() reads item.data.group (default: on for a document root's own sections, off elsewhere) and writes .panel-group. focus.js's drill()/step_out() resolve a click to the outermost unselected group on the path, one level in per repeat click, Escape one level out. panel.css gates hover so an unselected group's children get no bar/edge/display affordances and the group's own chrome lights instead. properties.js carries the on/off toggle (WORDS/live_words is leaf-only, cannot say 'splits only'). Whole-section drag needed no PanelDrag change — every panel with a parent already has a bar handle. Six numbered checks, zero console errors on Panel + editor: doc/focus.md 'Groups'.

**Relayed fix: PanelDrag centre-drop onto an EMPTY leaf.** Was duplicating a spurious blank sibling instead of nesting solo (split() always relocates content, even when there is none) — nest() now special-cases an empty target: the dropped panel becomes its sole child, the target keeps its own tone/words, --panel-pad: 1em set for panel-pad-gap to adopt. A target with content is unchanged. Proved both cases: doc/decisions.md 'Centre-drop onto a leaf'.
